Done. "Glint Research" wordmark now sits below the mark and reveals after the logo finishes:

- **Per-letter cascade** — each letter flips up from below (`rotateX` fold + rise) while unblurring, with springy overshoot easing, 45ms stagger left to right. Starts 0.35s after the last stroke lands, so the sequence reads: draw → settle pop → text.
- **Glint is orange** (#F97316), bold, with gradient `background-clip:text`. One second after the word lands, a lighter-orange shimmer sweeps across it letter by letter — fits the name.
- **Research** stays in the stroke color, thin-weight, letterspaced uppercase, so the orange carries the emphasis.
- Letter splitting happens in JS, timed off the same computed draw-end as the sweep — change `data-duration`/`data-stagger` and everything stays in sync. Reduced-motion users get the full wordmark statically; screen readers get "Glint Research" via aria-label instead of 13 letter spans.

Container went from fixed square to two rows (logo + text), svg keeps its square via `aspect-ratio`. Open `logo.html` to see it; font size scales with `--logo-size` (currently 8.5% of it — bump the `.085` if you want it bigger).
